Name: Dwarf Sells Cheaper Bombs
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
In the 1.6 update, the price of bombs changed as follows:

[b]Cherry Bomb:[/b] 300g -> 450g
[b]Bomb:[/b] 600g -> 1000g
[b]Mega Bomb: [/b]1000g -> 1600g

I get the theory behind this. The 1.5 prices were about equal to the cost of crafting them yourself, so why ever craft them?

However, I feel it could reasonably be somewhere in between. Plus, let's give another reason to talk to the Dwarf.

This mod changes their price as follows, if you have 8 hearts with the Dwarf:

[b]Cherry Bomb:[/b] 450g -> 337g
[b]Bomb:[/b] 1000g -> 750g
[b]Mega Bomb: [/b]1600g -> 1200g

I.E., a 25% discount.

It gets there gradually. Every 2 hearts, the prices of the Dwarf's shop items are reduced, until 8 hearts.

If you're interested in another mod that makes the Dwarf worth talking to in a relatively unintrusive way, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19091]Trinkets to Treasures (Simplified)[/url].

If you are big on logical shop price reductions, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16209]Price Buffs[/url], which has an option to reduce Joja's prices in-line with the lore.
